qrcodeData =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
            r["_field"] == "qrcode"
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            slot_key:
                string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
                string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
                string(v: r.position_id)
        }))
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
        )

        // Get latest QRCode for each slot
        |> group(columns: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ])
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)

        // Preserve QRCode timestamp for final deduplication
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            qr_time: r._time,
            qrcode: string(v: r._value),
            storehouse_id: r.storehouse_id,
            pallet_position: r.pallet_position,
            position_id: r.position_id
        }))
        |> group()


errorData =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
            r["_field"] == "error_value"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            slot_key:
                string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
                string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
                string(v: r.position_id)
        }))
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
        )

        // Get latest error value for each slot
        |> group(columns: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ])
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)

        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            error_value: r._value,
            storehouse_id: r.storehouse_id,
            pallet_position: r.pallet_position,
            position_id: r.position_id
        }))
        |> group()


codeData =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
            r["_field"] == "error_code"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            slot_key:
                string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
                string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
                string(v: r.position_id)
        }))
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
        )

        // Get latest error code for each slot
        |> group(columns: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ])
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)

        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            error_code: string(v: r._value),
            storehouse_id: r.storehouse_id,
            pallet_position: r.pallet_position,
            position_id: r.position_id
        }))
        |> group()


// Join error value and error code
errorWithCode =
    join(
        tables: {
            err: errorData,
            code: codeData
        },
        on: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ],
        method: "inner"
    )


// Join QRCode
result =
    join(
        tables: {
            data: errorWithCode,
            qr: qrcodeData
        },
        on: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ],
        method: "inner"
    )

        // Format error value according to error code
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r.qr_time,
            qrcode: r.qrcode,

            _value:
                if
                    r.error_code == "OV" or
                    r.error_code == "UV" or
                    r.error_code == "OVS" or
                    r.error_code == "OWVS" or
                    r.error_code == "OWVP"
                then
                    string(v: r.error_value) + " mV"

                else if
                    r.error_code == "OT" or
                    r.error_code == "OTS" or
                    r.error_code == "OTW" or
                    r.error_code == "OTF"
                then
                    string(v: float(v: r.error_value) / 10.0) + " Â°C"

                else if
                    r.error_code == "OC" or
                    r.error_code == "UC"
                then
                    string(v: r.error_value) + " mA"

                else if
                    r.error_code == "CTO"
                then
                    string(v: float(v: r.error_value) / 60000.0) + " Mins"

                else
                    string(v: r.error_value)
        }))


// Each QRCode keeps only its latest record
result
    |> group(columns: ["qrcode"])

    |> sort(
        columns: ["_time"],
        desc: true
    )

    |> limit(n: 1)

    // Final Grafana output
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        qrcode: r.qrcode,
        _value: r._value
    }))

base =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(
        start: v.timeRangeStart,
        stop: v.timeRangeStop
    )

    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
        (
            r["_field"] == "qrcode" or
            r["_field"] == "serialboard_id" or
            r["_field"] == "protectboard_id" or
            r["_field"] == "voltage" or
            r["_field"] == "temperature" or
            r["_field"] == "current" or
            r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_1" or
            r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_2" or
            r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_3" or
            r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_4" or
            r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_5"
        )
    )

    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/
    )

    // Generate slot key
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        r with
        slot_key:
            string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
            string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
            string(v: r.position_id)
    }))

    // Final dashboard filter
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
    )

    // Convert fields to columns
    |> pivot(
        rowKey: [
            "_time",
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id",
            "return_code"
        ],
        columnKey: ["_field"],
        valueColumn: "_value"
    )


//
// Cell Voltage
//
voltData =
    base
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        exists r.qrcode and
        exists r.serialboard_id and
        exists r.protectboard_id and
        exists r.voltage
    )

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field:
            "01_" +
            string(v: r.qrcode) +
            "_Volt",

        _value: float(v: r.voltage)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Cell Temperature
//
tempData =
    base
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        exists r.qrcode and
        exists r.serialboard_id and
        exists r.protectboard_id and
        exists r.temperature
    )

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field:
            "02_" +
            string(v: r.qrcode) +
            "_Temp",

        _value: float(v: r.temperature)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Board-level data
// Current / Wire Voltage are repeated for each Cell,
// so keep only one record for the same board at the same time.
//
boardBase =
    base
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        exists r.serialboard_id and
        exists r.protectboard_id and
        exists r.current and
        exists r.wire_voltage_1 and
        exists r.wire_voltage_2 and
        exists r.wire_voltage_3 and
        exists r.wire_voltage_4 and
        exists r.wire_voltage_5
    )

    |> group(columns: [
        "_time",
        "return_code",
        "storehouse_id",
        "serialboard_id",
        "protectboard_id"
    ])

    |> limit(n: 1)

    |> group()


//
// Current
//
currentData =
    boardBase
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field: "03_Current",
        _value: float(v: r.current)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Wire Voltage 1
//
wire1 =
    boardBase
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field: "04_WireVolt_1",
        _value: float(v: r.wire_voltage_1)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Wire Voltage 2
//
wire2 =
    boardBase
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field: "04_WireVolt_2",
        _value: float(v: r.wire_voltage_2)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Wire Voltage 3
//
wire3 =
    boardBase
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field: "04_WireVolt_3",
        _value: float(v: r.wire_voltage_3)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Wire Voltage 4
//
wire4 =
    boardBase
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field: "04_WireVolt_4",
        _value: float(v: r.wire_voltage_4)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Wire Voltage 5
//
wire5 =
    boardBase
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,

        ReturnCode: r.return_code,
        StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
        SerialBoardID: string(v: r.serialboard_id),
        ProtectBoardID: string(v: r.protectboard_id),

        _field: "04_WireVolt_5",
        _value: float(v: r.wire_voltage_5)
    }))

    |> group(columns: [
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID",
        "_field"
    ])

    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: last,
        createEmpty: false
    )


//
// Combine all data
//
union(tables: [
    voltData,
    tempData,
    currentData,
    wire1,
    wire2,
    wire3,
    wire4,
    wire5
])

|> keep(columns: [
    "_time",
    "_field",
    "_value",
    "ReturnCode",
    "StoreHouseID",
    "SerialBoardID",
    "ProtectBoardID"
])

|> group(columns: [])

|> pivot(
    rowKey: [
        "_time",
        "ReturnCode",
        "StoreHouseID",
        "SerialBoardID",
        "ProtectBoardID"
    ],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
)

|> sort(
    columns: [
        "_time",
        "ReturnCode",
        "SerialBoardID"
    ]
)

|> filter(fn: (r) =>

|> filter(fn: (r) =>

    // Same SerialBoard at same time may appear in multiple positions.
    // Keep only one copy.
    |> group(columns: [
        "serialboard_id",

    |> limit(n: 1)

    |> group()

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({

    "_value"

WITH Latest AS
(
    SELECT

list.label: SelectExportData
list.name: select_export_data
list.query: Voltage : voltage, Temperature : temperature, Current : current, WireVoltage : wire_voltage

current.text: r["_field"] == "voltage" or r["_field"] == "temperature" or r["_field"] == "current" or r["_field"] == "wire_voltage"
current.value: r["_field"] == "voltage" or r["_field"] == "temperature" or r["_field"] == "current" or r["_field"] == "wire_voltage"

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${select_export_data:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["_field"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(
      start: v.timeRangeStart,
      stop: v.timeRangeStop
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
      (
          r["_field"] == "serialboard_id" or
          r["_field"] == "protectboard_id"
      )
  )
